closure_rationale.schema_version: parent freezes the field but not its exact value
closure_rationale.generation: parent freezes the identity field but not initial generation or replacement semantics
closure_rationale.cng_key_name: parent constrains encoding but does not select the exact successor machine key name
closure_rationale.client_package_acceptance: a public expected_device_key fingerprint restricts a target but does not prove local private-key possession
closure_rationale.custody_wire_evidence: parent freezes custody identifiers and gates but does not freeze the complete public evidence object or request-bound qualifyingData
closure_rationale.creation_attestation_digest: parent names the digest but does not select raw TPMS_ATTEST versus its transport envelope
closure_rationale.durable_lifecycle: parent freezes status progression and ACTIVE identity but not creation reservation, crash recovery or retained creation time

canonicalization.canonical_utc: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; whole UTC seconds, real Gregorian date, no offset or fractional seconds

binding_artifact.digest: lowercase hex SHA256(exact canonical binding payload bytes)
binding_artifact.created_at_utc: internally captured creation reservation UTC truncated to whole seconds and durably retained before any native creation effect; identical across retry and restart

target_package_acceptance.required_local_key: exact factory-issued WindowsCNGPreEnrollmentKey with current native qualification and committed durable identity
target_package_acceptance.target_bindings: exact request, package, verified production TPM exchange and target projection; request SEC1 bytes and fingerprint equal the reopened local key; recompute every digest
target_package_acceptance.nonce: 32 internally generated CSPRNG bytes encoded as exactly 64 lowercase hex characters; caller-supplied nonce prohibited
target_package_acceptance.signing_key: exact locally qualified pre-enrollment private key authenticated by the request and package
target_package_acceptance.verification_key: exact request SEC1 uncompressed P-256 bytes, 65 bytes 0x04 || X32 || Y32; recomputed SHA256 fingerprint equals package and local key
target_package_acceptance.freshness: new nonce and verified signature within each acceptance invocation; a retained prior signature or caller-visible acceptance evidence never grants reusable package acceptance authority
target_package_acceptance.retention: Each successful accept invocation retains its exact challenge, signature and live TPM proof in the private immutable runtime capability for its lifetime. The first invocation is copied into the durable creation reservation and remains byte-identical across retries. Retry acceptance evidence belongs to the new runtime capability; it does not overwrite initial durable audit history. Guard requalification proofs are ephemeral current-use checks, never capability reconstruction inputs.
target_package_acceptance.expiry: recheck current genuine trust and issued_at_utc <= internal current UTC < expires_at_utc on initial acceptance, retry, restart and before ACTIVE commit
target_package_acceptance.capability: exact-type verifier-issued private registry capability bound to current context, exact package/request bytes, verified target and exact native local key; reject copied, forged, subclassed or caller-created values
target_package_acceptance.live_creation_qualifying_data: SHA256(UTF8(live_creation_domain) || 0x00 || SHA256(exact canonical acceptance challenge bytes))
target_package_acceptance.live_creation: collect fresh TPM2_CertifyCreation with the exact reopened locally qualified pre-enrollment subject and exact retained restricted target AK; independent verifier checks exact request custody TPMT_PUBLIC/Name, current SEC1 point, creationHash and fresh qualifyingData against genuine production target exchange
target_package_acceptance.live_creation_retention: Retain exact raw TPMS_ATTEST excluding TPM2B length and raw TPMT_SIGNATURE with the invocation challenge/signature in the runtime capability; retain the first invocation in durable history. Fresh guard requalification does not replace retained binding or attestation bytes. Old evidence cannot authorize another invocation.

successor_key.public_encoding: canonical raw TPMT_PUBLIC bytes; reject TPM2B_PUBLIC length wrapper, CNG blob, SEC1, SPKI, PEM and JSON as authority fingerprint input
successor_key.fingerprint: lowercase hex SHA256(canonical raw TPMT_PUBLIC bytes)
successor_key.tpm_name: lowercase hex(0x000b || SHA256(canonical raw TPMT_PUBLIC bytes))
successor_key.fingerprint_distinction: pre-enrollment fingerprint hashes exact SEC1 bytes, successor fingerprint hashes exact TPMT_PUBLIC bytes; separately compare SEC1 points and TPM Names to reject same-key promotion
successor_key.reserved_key_missing: FAIL_CLOSED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; never mint a second successor
successor_key.native_qualification: exact hardware provider, no software implementation; exact key name and committed Unique Name; ECDSA P-256, signing-only, machine scope, Export Policy 0 and PCP_EXPORT_ALLOWED false; these properties alone are not TPM creation custody

custody_evidence.digest_input: exact raw marshaled TPMS_ATTEST bytes from CertifyCreation, excluding the transport TPM2B_ATTEST length prefix
custody_evidence.qualifying_data_rule: SHA256(UTF8(domain) || 0x00 || JCS_UTF8(exact qualifying_data_fields object)); no binding digest in the object, avoiding a binding/attestation digest cycle
custody_evidence.subject_profile: TPM2 ECC P-256/SHA-256 with exact ECDSA-SHA256 scheme; fixedTPM + fixedParent + sensitiveDataOrigin + userWithAuth + sign attributes 0x40072, optionally noDA giving 0x40472; empty authPolicy; reject NULL scheme and all other attributes
custody_evidence.collector: exact reopened and qualified successor CNG subject; provider-owned borrowed TBS context; exact existing retained machine AK open-only; no AK creation/import, alternate subject, context ownership or TPM resource flushing
custody_evidence.verifier: independently verify production target endorsement/exchange provenance and exact restricted AK from the verified target projection; verify real AK-signed TPM_ST_ATTEST_CREATION, subject Name, creationHash, qualifyingData and raw public digest
custody_evidence.cng_identity: exact qualified local provider/key/Unique Name must match retained lifecycle, binding and custody evidence; caller claims alone are rejected
custody_evidence.missing_or_unsupported_native_creation_p: FAIL_CLOSED; never substitute a synthetic attestation or property-only custody

signature_profiles.encoding: strict minimal ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE(INTEGER r, INTEGER low-S s); reject malformed, non-minimal, trailing bytes, zero, out-of-range and high-S
signature_profiles.continuity_signed_bytes: UTF8(continuity_domain) || 0x00 || SHA256(exact canonical LPPIAuthorityKeyBindingV1 payload bytes)
signature_profiles.continuity_signer: exact pre-enrollment key authenticated by request and package; fingerprint recomputed from request SEC1 bytes
signature_profiles.authority_pop_signer: exact candidate successor key; verification SEC1 point derived from independently parsed exact TPMT_PUBLIC

durable_lifecycle.scope: one initial successor lifecycle in the trusted configured local machine state path; immutable package/request/subject/enrollment/target identity; no replacement generations
durable_lifecycle.reservation: durably reserve exact acceptance bindings, Production Trust identity, fixed provider/key name and created_at_utc before any native identity-generating effect; acquire exclusive lifecycle ownership
durable_lifecycle.recovery: RECONCILE opens the exact fixed CNG name only when creation_outcome is OWN_FINALIZE_PENDING or OWN_FINALIZED, proving successful own Create with a nonempty handle and applied properties before Finalize. If exact SEC1/Unique Name is retained, RECOVER must match it. An attempt marker, qualified public profile, CREATE_COLLISION or CREATE_FAILED never permits adoption; missing owned identity fails closed without remint.
durable_lifecycle.candidate_commit: persist exact reopened qualified CNG Unique Name, raw TPMT_PUBLIC, recomputed fingerprint/Name, attestation, canonical binding and creation timestamp; mismatches fail closed
durable_lifecycle.signature_retention: persist exact continuity and successor PoP signature bytes before progression; retry reuses retained bytes after cryptographic revalidation and never changes candidate identity
durable_lifecycle.history: retain every frozen status in order, with exact immutable binding and evidence; trusted restart loader re-verifies proofs and the complete history rather than trusting status flags
durable_lifecycle.final_commit: atomic exactly-one ACTIVE commit only after all five verification gates, current trust/package validity, native requalification, custody revalidation and exact retained binding matches
durable_lifecycle.active_immutable: profile, fingerprint, custody, TPM Name, raw TPMT_PUBLIC, binding digest, package/request/subject/enrollment/target identities and CNG provider/name/Unique Name
durable_lifecycle.retry: same package/enrollment/request/target returns exact same successor identity, binding, retained signatures and created_at_utc; recheck expiry and current trust; lost ACTIVE response cannot create another key
durable_lifecycle.conflicts: any changed package, request, subject, enrollment reference, target projection/exchange, CNG Unique Name, canonical TPMT_PUBLIC, binding or history fails closed with stable conflict error
durable_lifecycle.rollback_claim: trusted local durable state and requalification provide local continuity; this block does not claim authenticated rollback-proof storage or TPM NV freshness

storage.representation: one canonical JSON singleton; exact fields, atomic same-directory replace after file fsync, exclusive process lock; reject symlinks, reparse points, hardlinked state; directory fsync where supported
storage.boundary: installer-owned trusted machine state; caller-selected paths and reconstructed public rows cannot issue runtime authority

durable_lifecycle.creation_attempt: NOT_ATTEMPTED and creation_attempted=false are a durable reservation before any attempted effect; set ATTEMPT_STARTED and creation_attempted=true and fsync before NCryptCreatePersistedKey. Only the first invocation private reservation may attempt native Create, without open-first fallback. Restart of ATTEMPT_STARTED fails closed before open/create. A never-attempted reservation may resume its sole first attempt. Successful own Create with a nonempty handle and applied properties permits OWN_FINALIZE_PENDING, durably fsynced before the sole Finalize call; only OWN_FINALIZE_PENDING or OWN_FINALIZED permits open-only reconciliation.
durable_lifecycle.candidate_identity_retention: When own native handle can be qualified after successful or returned ambiguous non-collision Finalize, persist its exact SEC1 and CNG Unique Name before free/reopen and require exact matching thereafter. NTE_EXISTS never permits qualification. If own-handle qualification after ambiguous Finalize is unavailable, or process crash precedes retention, retain OWN_FINALIZE_PENDING and permit only own-stage-authorized open-only reconciliation. After qualified reopen retain exact SEC1/Unique Name while CREATION_RESERVED and set OWN_FINALIZED; subsequently retain full TPMT_PUBLIC and binding at CANDIDATE. Missing or changed retained identity fails closed.
durable_lifecycle.active_requalification: Before restoring or consuming ACTIVE capability: independently reverify all retained signatures and acceptance audit evidence, exact status history and package expiry; open exact successor CNG identity, perform live TPM ReadPublic/CertifyCreation and compare all qualifying-data fields with retained custody, then verify fresh successor private-key PoP without replacing retained binding/signatures.

create.authorization: only the first invocation exact private creation reservation

reconcile.retained_identity_match: exact SEC1 and CNG Unique Name when already retained

ambiguous_finalize.own_handle_identity_retention: after Finalize when own handle qualification succeeds, before free/reopen
ambiguous_finalize.qualification_unavailable_or_process_cra: retain own-stage-authorized open-only reconciliation without remint

active_capability.name: VerifiedActiveLPPIAuthorityKey
active_capability.source: complete cryptographic verification plus durable ACTIVE commit, or trusted durable loader plus fresh target acceptance and CNG/TPM requalification
active_capability.provenance: exact type, private weak registry, immutable snapshot, current genuine Production Trust, exact native issued key and recomputed consequential durable state
active_capability.consumer_rule: accept exact ACTIVE profile, fingerprint and custody from verified capability; caller key, alias, key ID, CNG name or ACTIVE status alone never establishes signing authority

qualification.mocked_native: MECHANICS_ONLY; native calls and cryptographic fixture tests are not physical TPM custody proof
